summary: The fixture permits cross-account reads and updates under the exercise's stated assumptions.

findings.title: Caller-controlled owner changes the SQL predicate
findings.impact: A caller can read task rows belonging to other accounts.
findings.evidence: The owner is interpolated into SQL. The payload ' OR 1=1 -- makes the WHERE condition true for every row.
findings.suggestion: Bind owner as a SQL parameter.

findings.title: Completion ignores the authenticated actor
findings.impact: A caller who knows another task ID can change its status.
findings.evidence: The UPDATE predicate contains only id; the actor parameter is unused.
findings.suggestion: Constrain the update by both task ID and authenticated owner.

limitations: The fixture is deliberately vulnerable and does not represent a deployed service.
